tranche: t3 extension, Owner 'authorize' scratch-only, ceiling +3.5M (10.4M pane total), 2026-10-26
group: user agent listing: the 95 files of ~/.claude/agents (PROPOSAL.md row 1). Plugin and project agents are not removed, so this measures the user-agent share only
mechanism: process env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR -> a scratch dir holding CLAUDE.md, rules/, agents/ copies and a temporary copy of .credentials.json (deleted after the run); treated arm omits agents/. Live ~/.claude is not written. Control and treated both lack settings.json, hooks and skills, equally
instrument: python tools/floor_regression_gate.py --check --probe --cwd <repo> --json with CPP_CLAUDE_EXE = scratch wrapper that sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; results to b3/probe-results-c3cd.jsonl; floor from tools/context_floor_census.py
design: 2 repos (PP repo, mcp-video-analyzer) x [control, no-agents, no-rules] = 6 probes; control shared with C3d; fixed prompt 'Reply with the single word OK.'

frozen_saving_band_tokens.basis: B3.md agent_listing_delta mean 10,624 ESTIMATE; low = ~0.28x allowing the C3a 0.72x haircut plus plugin/project agents that stay

pass_rule: a probe passes when its result is the word OK and the census gives a MEASURED call-1 floor

verdict_rule.CERTIFIED: all probes of both arms pass AND both pairs' (control floor - no-agents floor) inside the band
verdict_rule.REFUTED: all pass AND at least one delta outside the band
verdict_rule.UNMEASURABLE: scratch config rejected, auth fails, any probe fails or has no measured floor

known_limits: control floor will be well below organic (no skills, hooks, settings); the delta is the claim, not the absolute floor. N=2 pairs bound no variance.
